integrity: The proof uses an exact gap-spanning formula for the expected range, a centered cumulative-cut decomposition for the parent variance, and an exact covariance representation with a strictly increasing cellwise range score. The lower and upper endpoints, equality cases, and interval filling are analytic; exact-rational computation is supplementary.
scientific_limitations: The theorem fixes a finite positive atom-probability vector and varies only the distinct ordered support locations.
Sampling is independent and identically distributed, and the result concerns only the expected range normalized by the parent standard deviation.
The order-statistic projection literature is extensive, so an equivalent fixed-partition formulation may exist under different notation.
title: Exact fixed-profile range of expected sample range relative to standard deviation
